meta.philosophy: Conservative starting loads. Better to ramp up than blow a tendon. Bodyweight = 0 lb. Band colors: yellow < red < green < blue < black. Bias toward unilateral, cable, machine, and short-lever variants over heavy barbell work given peroneal, medial-epicondyle, and arch susceptibility.

exercises.name: Landmine press
exercises.notes: Conservative start (25 lb plate on landmine). Shoulder/elbow-friendly diagonal press; post-SLAP-safe substitute for OHP.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling landmine press
exercises.notes: Lower than standing landmine — half-kneeling kills momentum and exposes core demand.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raises
exercises.notes: Cable constant-tension is gentler on shoulder than DB swing-and-cheat. Light load, strict form.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raises
exercises.notes: Strict, no momentum.

exercises.name: Push-ups on rings/handles
exercises.notes: Neutral grip on handles/rings = elbow-friendly (medial epicondyle). AMRAP, leave 2 in the tank.

exercises.name: Suspension trainer push-ups
exercises.notes: TRX push-up; instability adds scap stabilizer demand. AMRAP.

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.notes: Standard floor push-up. AMRAP.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.notes: Per dumbbell. Neutral or slight pronation; shoulder-friendlier than flat barbell.

exercises.name: Flat dumbbell press
exercises.notes: Per dumbbell. Lighter than bench press since you control range.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
exercises.notes: Total stack weight; fixed path is shoulder-friendly.

exercises.name: Face pulls + external rotation
exercises.notes: Light. Pause at end range with external rotation. Daily-safe shoulder prehab.

exercises.name: Face pulls
exercises.notes: High-rep, light, daily-safe.

exercises.name: Cable triceps pushdown
exercises.notes: Rope or straight bar. Keep elbows pinned; avoid medial elbow flare.

exercises.name: Overhead triceps extension
exercises.notes: Single DB two-handed or rope. Watch elbow if golfer's elbow flares — sub in pushdowns.

exercises.name: Skull crushers
exercises.notes: EZ bar weight. Elbow-stressful — proceed only when medial epicondyle is quiet.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.notes: Bodyweight. Stop short of shoulder pain; post-SLAP caution.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable row
exercises.notes: Per side. Constant tension, controlled tempo.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell row
exercises.notes: Per dumbbell. Bench-supported, no spinal rotation.

exercises.name: Suspension trainer rows
exercises.notes: TRX/ring row. Adjust difficulty via foot position. AMRAP.

exercises.name: Chest-supported row
exercises.notes: Removes lower-back demand. Squeeze 1s at top.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.notes: Total stack. Don't yank with lumbar.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.notes: Neutral grip is shoulder-friendliest.

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.notes: Bodyweight. Sub in band-assisted if medial elbow flares.

exercises.name: Chin-ups
exercises.notes: Higher bicep recruitment. Watch medial elbow.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bicep curl
exercises.notes: Per dumbbell. Start light — biceps load is medial-epicondyle adjacent.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
exercises.notes: Per dumbbell. Neutral grip — friendliest to medial elbow.

exercises.name: Cable curl
exercises.notes: Constant tension; easier to control eccentric than DBs.

exercises.name: Reverse curl
exercises.notes: Wrist extensor + brachioradialis. Direct golfer's-elbow prehab.

exercises.name: Hip thrusts
exercises.notes: Bar weight (95 = 45 bar + 25/side). Pause 1s at top, ribs down.

exercises.name: Single-leg hip thrust
exercises.notes: Bodyweight, shoulders on bench. Hits glute med + glute max unilaterally.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlifts (soft knees)
exercises.notes: Bar weight. Hinge from hips, neutral spine, soft knees. Hamstring length > load.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlifts
exercises.notes: Bar weight. Conservative — RDLs are the bedrock hamstring lift.

exercises.name: Single-leg RDL
exercises.notes: Per dumbbell, per side. Balance is the load early on; don't chase weight.

exercises.name: Reverse lunges (short step, front foot flat)
exercises.notes: Per dumbbell. Short step + front foot flat protects patellofemoral and ankle.

exercises.name: Reverse lunges (short step)
exercises.notes: Per dumbbell.

exercises.name: Reverse lunges
exercises.notes: Per dumbbell.

exercises.name: Walking lunges
exercises.notes: 8 per side. Per dumbbell.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.notes: Per dumbbell. Knee-friendly with long stance; harsh with short stance.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.notes: Single DB. Front-loaded = thoracic-friendly, easier to keep torso upright.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.notes: Conservative start (one plate). Box squat variant is patellofemoral-friendlier.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.notes: Lighter than back squat. Thoracic + wrist demand — watch elbow.

exercises.name: Trap bar deadlift
exercises.notes: Friendlier than conventional DL for most. Stop sets with 2 in the tank.

exercises.name: Conventional deadlift
exercises.notes: One plate. Lower-back-stressful; pull only when warm + braced.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
exercises.notes: Hip-hinge driven, not squat. Glute snap at top.

exercises.name: Farmer carries
exercises.notes: Per dumbbell. 30s walk. Grip + posture under load; tendon-friendly.

exercises.name: Suitcase carries
exercises.notes: Per side. Anti-lateral-flexion — fights side-bend, brutal for obliques.

exercises.name: Overhead carries
exercises.notes: Per dumbbell. Shoulder-positional; skip if shoulder is reactive.

exercises.name: Step-ups
exercises.notes: Per dumbbell, per side. Drive through whole foot — no calf-bounce.

exercises.name: Calf raises (straight + bent knee)
exercises.notes: Daily-safe. Gastroc (straight) + soleus (bent). Slow eccentric (3s down) — peroneal/Achilles tendon-friendly loading.

exercises.name: Calf raises
exercises.notes: Bodyweight, slow eccentric.

exercises.name: Eccentric eversion (peroneal)
exercises.notes: Yellow (lightest) band. Slow 3-4s eccentric — this is the core peroneal rehab move. Daily.

exercises.name: Eccentric eversion
exercises.notes: Yellow band. Daily peroneal rehab.

exercises.name: Wrist extension
exercises.notes: Yellow band or 2-3 lb DB. Medial-epicondyle rehab via wrist extensor strengthening.

exercises.name: Wrist extension + supination training
exercises.notes: Yellow band. Adds supination — full-spectrum elbow tendon prehab.

exercises.name: Wrist flexion
exercises.notes: Yellow band. Balances wrist extensor work.

exercises.name: Band pull-aparts
exercises.notes: Red band. Daily-safe scap retractor / posterior delt activation.

exercises.name: Band walks
exercises.notes: Red mini-band above knees or around ankles. Glute med activation for hip/knee tracking.

exercises.name: Clamshells
exercises.notes: Red mini-band. Glute med isolation — hip impingement-friendly.

exercises.name: Glute bridges
exercises.notes: Bodyweight activation. Pause 1s at top.

exercises.name: Glute activation (band walks, glute bridges)
exercises.notes: Red mini-band. Pre-lower-body warmup routine.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.notes: Per side, cable weight. Anti-rotation — squeeze ribs down, no twist.

exercises.name: Dead bugs
exercises.notes: Per side. Lower back glued to floor; slow tempo.

exercises.name: Bird dogs
exercises.notes: Per side. Hover 1s — anti-rotation + scap stability.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.notes: Per side. Stack hips, neutral neck.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.notes: Ribs down, squeeze glutes. Stop when form breaks, not when timer ends.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.notes: Low back pressed into floor; scale by arm/leg position.

exercises.name: Hanging knee raise
exercises.notes: No swing. Grip is medial-elbow-stressful — keep volume modest.

exercises.name: Copenhagen plank
exercises.notes: Per side. Adductor isometric — groin-injury prehab. Start with short-lever (knee on bench).

exercises.name: 90/90 hip switches
exercises.notes: Per side. Hip IR/ER mobility — pre-lower-body essential for hip impingement.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
exercises.notes: Per side. Squeeze rear glute to deepen the stretch (don't just lean).

exercises.name: Half-kneeling adductor rocks
exercises.notes: Per side. Gentle adductor mobilization.

exercises.name: Couch stretch
exercises.notes: Per side. Deep quad/hip flexor. Squeeze glute to protect lumbar.

exercises.name: Cat-cow / thoracic mobility
exercises.notes: Daily-safe spine mobility primer.

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.notes: Daily-safe.

exercises.name: Thoracic mobility
exercises.notes: Open-book, quadruped rotations, or foam-roller extensions.

exercises.name: Scapular CARs
exercises.notes: Controlled articular rotations. Slow circles through full scap ROM.

exercises.name: Wall slides
exercises.notes: Lower back + arms in contact with wall. Shoulder posture reset.

exercises.name: Pigeon pose
exercises.notes: Per side. Glute/piriformis. Stack hips square; don't force depth.

exercises.name: Lizard pose
exercises.notes: Per side. Deep hip-opener; gentle on impinged hips with elbows on a block.

exercises.name: Thoracic openers (sphinx, prone scorpion)
exercises.notes: Open chest + thoracic extension. Easy on lumbar if you breathe into ribs.

exercises.name: Hamstring stretches (active, not forced)
exercises.notes: Active range — soft knees, no bouncing. Length over force.

exercises.name: Single-leg balance work
exercises.notes: Per side. Eyes-open → eyes-closed → unstable surface. Peroneal proprioception.

exercises.name: Tibialis raises
exercises.notes: Heels-down toe raises against wall. Anterior shin balance to calf work.

exercises.name: Toe yoga
exercises.notes: Big-toe up vs other-toes-up, alternating. Intrinsic foot muscles for arch.

exercises.name: Short foot / arch doming
exercises.notes: Per side. Pull ball of foot toward heel without curling toes. Foot arch rehab.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.notes: Step-back variant if peroneal flares; no high-impact landings until pain-free 5k.

exercises.name: Mountain climbers
exercises.notes: Hips low, controlled tempo.

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.notes: Watch peroneal — sub in step-jacks if reactive.

exercises.name: Air squat
exercises.notes: Bodyweight.

exercises.name: Wall sit
exercises.notes: Patellofemoral-friendly isometric — great when squats flare the knee.

exercises.name: Spanish squat
exercises.notes: Band around knees pulling back; sit into iso. Strongest evidence for patellar tendinopathy.

exercises.name: Isometric calf hold
exercises.notes: Top-of-calf-raise hold. Pain-modulating isometric for Achilles/peroneal.

exercises.name: Dead hang
exercises.notes: Active scap engagement. Grip-stressful — watch medial elbow.

exercises.name: Scapular pull-ups
exercises.notes: Just scap depression — no elbow bend. Lat activation primer.
